messages:
maria.cho: FYI bringing up mosaic-13b-delta (community fork) for the web-search pilot. Need a short quant plan: int8 / FP8 / gguf hybrid. Latency target p95 < 160ms on dedicated a100x4 pool. Cost target: ~30% cheaper than fp16. Prioritizing quality for reranking, embeddings can tolerate a bit more loss. Any objections?

jon.sinha: no objections. quick checklist suggestion: calibration dataset defined, primary eval sets, sensitivity thresholds, rollout gating, and a fallback plan. keep it 1-pager.

lina.ng: I can own calibration runs. propose: 5k calibration samples spanning short queries (<=32 tokens) and long queries (>=256). seed=42; batch=8 for int8; also run batch=1 to capture latency tail.

zane: add kv-cache warmup scenarios to emulate real traffic. For gguf, test both per-tensor and per-channel quant, and test mixed-precision (heads in fp16).

infra-bot: deploy-bot: created job q-run-1994527890 (calib + smoke). status: queued.

jon.sinha: config snippet for the run: ```json
{
  "model": "mosaic-13b-delta",
  "quant_modes": ["int8", "fp8", "gguf"],
  "calib_samples": 5000,
  "seed": 42,
  "batch": 8,
  "eval_sets": ["web-search-short", "web-search-long", "semantic-embeddings"]
}
```

maria.cho: Eval thresholds: use our rerank_mrr metric (primary), and embedding-avg-cos for embedding sets. Gate: fail deploy if MRR drops > 2% absolute vs fp16 on the primary set, or embeddings avg-cos drops > 0.015. Also fail if latency p95 regresses > 15%.

lina.ng: I'll run int8 first. rough expectations: int8 MRR delta +/-1.5% typical; fp8 usually tighter +/-0.8%. If int8 fails, try per-channel symmetric or activation clipping.

zane: cost ballpark for sizing: fp16 = 1.00 unit, int8 = 0.62 unit, fp8 = 0.71 unit (rough). If int8 hits latency while meeting quality, that meets our cost goal. If p95 is too high, can autoscale to burst or fallback to fp16 for canary traffic.

jon.sinha: capture perf + accuracy artifacts in a single ZIP for release engineering gating. tag images: mosaic-13b-delta:quant-1994527890 and include git hash + quant config.

maria.cho: timeline: try first-pass smoke + calib tonight, full sweep tomorrow. Lina, can you post first-pass numbers by EOD tomorrow? @evals-bot please start collecting logs on completion. :thumbsup:

evals-bot: evals-bot: kicked off run id eval-1994527890. ETA ~6h.

lina.ng: quick update: int8 smoke done locally — latency p95 ~150ms (batch=1 sim), MRR -1.3% vs fp16 on the short set. Starting fp8 sweep now; will post full artifacts once job finishes.
